Grid Search Results Viewer¶

Load results from a previous grid search run and visualize them.

  1. Set RESULTS_DIR to the folder you want to inspect
  2. Run all cells
In [1]:
import sys; sys.path.insert(0, "..")
%load_ext autoreload
%autoreload 2

from pipeline.Benchmark import Benchmark
